blocking_items.title: The 0.34% historical harm is not a new-panel F0 break-even theorem
blocking_items.conclusion: The measured 0.3392558% is normalized by historical F0 loss; Fs-relative recovery on that same panel is 0.3381088%. On another panel the break-even harm is a new paired estimate, not this fixed number.
blocking_items.minimal_action: Keep 0.0034 only as an explicitly chosen Fs-relative engineering screen, not a proven utility threshold. Report same-DEV paired Fs/F0/policy contrasts after prediction freeze and separate dynamic-versus-static evidence.
